The Catalyst: The Domestication of Wealth
The New Wealth
Pastoral peoples (Semites, Aryans)
acquired unprecedented surplus property
in the form of domesticated herds and
captured slaves to tend them.
The Male Domain
According to the gendered division of labor,
the man was responsible for procuring
food and owning the instruments of labor.
He therefore owned the new herds.
The Crisis
As wealth multiplied exponentially, the man's
position grew stronger than the woman's.
But under Mother-Right, his children could
not inherit his massive new wealth.

Primitive Democracy
Attribute 1: No Public Force
No soldiers, no gendarmes, no police, no prisons. All
disputes are settled by the community affected.
Attribute 3: Total Equality
Liberty, equality, and fraternity were the cardinal
principles. All members were personally free and equal in
rights- -women included.
Attribute 2: Blood Revenge
The individual looked for security to the protection of the
gens. To wrong an individual was to wrong their entire gens.
Attribute 4: Collective Welfare
The communal household and the gens systematically
cared for the old, sick, and disabled. Poverty as a
structural condition did not exist.

The Disruption of the Blood Tie
Mechanism of Collapse:
With the rise of private property, products
became commodities. When producers lost
direct control over their product through
exchange, wealth concentrated in a few hands.

Property, Arms, and
the Roman State
Context:
As Rome expanded, immigrants and conquered peoples
swelled the population. They were free, but excluded from
the patrician Populus. They became the Plebs.
The Servian Reforms:
To manage this, the new constitution grouped the population
into six classes strictly by property wealth (asses).
The Mechanism:
The wealthiest classes commanded the cavalry and
heavy infantry, and thus held the vast majority of voting
power (98 out of 193 centuries).
Result:
The old gentile blood-assembly was degraded to a
religious relic. Power was now a function of wealth.

The Invention
of the Police
Definition
The State requires a "public force"
separated from the mass of the

The Gentile Spirit
The free Athenian considered
politics police duty so degrading and
infamous that he would rather be
arrested by an armed slave than do

The Athenian Irony
The first police force in Athens was a
gendarmerie of slaves (bowmen).
Takeaway
The primitive democracy of "the people in
arms" was replaced by an alienated force
directed against the people.

Synthesis Insight: Sexism, class oppression, and the state were not natural human defaults. They
are historical inventions born at the exact same moment, driven by the exact same mechanism:
the need to protect and bequeath privately owned surplus wealth.

The Proletarian Exception
The Economic Void:
For the modern working class (the proletariat),
there is no massive property to bequeath.
Therefore, the primary incentive to enforce male
supremacy and strict, loveless monogamy
vanishes.
The Return of Choice:
Stripped of property considerations, the
proletarian family is the only sphere where
individual, mutual sex-love can become the sole
actual basis of marriage.
The Future:
If the means of production become socialized, the
anxiety of inheritance disappears. The single family
ceases to be the economic unit of society, and
care of children becomes a public affair.

The Museum of Antiquity
Conclusion: The state has not existed from all eternity. Societies managed perfectly well without
it. It became a necessity only because of the cleavage of society into classes.
"Society, which will reorganize production on the basis of a free and equal association of the
producers, will put the whole machinery of state where it will then belong: into the museum of
antiquity, by the side of the spinning-wheel and the bronze axe." - Friedrich Engels
